pages.title: Celestial Ritual
pages.text: Celestial Ritual is a nighttime Nature's Ritual that draws energy from nearby living Celestial Blooms. Its catalyst rests on the Ritual Table while salted Ritual Braziers hold the offerings.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Set up the Ritual Table and $(l:hexalia:blocks/ritual_brazier)Ritual Braziers$(/l) as for Nature's Ritual. Salt each selected Brazier. Living $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#celestial_bloom)Celestial Blooms$(/l) at the Table's height supply the recipe's required energy. Begin at night.

pages.title: Process
pages.text: Place the catalyst on the Ritual Table and the recipe's offerings in nearby salted Braziers. Activate the Table with a Hex Focus at night. Offerings travel to the Table while the Blooms send energy toward it.

pages.title: Transformation
pages.text: If the ritual completes while it is still night and the selected Blooms remain, the catalyst becomes the output on the Table. The selected Blooms become Dead Bushes. A cancelled ritual does not consume Blooms.

pages.title: On Use
pages.text: Galeberries and Celestial Crystals provide early progression; Moonweave upgrades use the same ritual structure with greater Bloom costs.
